overview_description: List the payments and refunds included in a bank reconciliation.
intro: A reconciliation matches payments and refunds against a bank statement. This area has 2 endpoints, which list the payments and the refunds in one reconciliation. Every SDK supports all of them.
warning: **No successful response from these lists has been confirmed yet.** The record fields and the paging style of both lists are not documented.
notes: **There is no endpoint for the reconciliation itself.** Only the two lists of its payments and refunds are available.
**Name the reconciliation by its uuid or its numeric id.** Both forms are accepted in `{reconciliation_id}`.
**An unknown reconciliation returns `404`.** The error code is `resource_not_found`.
**Records are under `data`.** Both lists put their records under `data`.

endpoints.title: List a reconciliation's payments
endpoints.summary: Returns the payments included in a reconciliation.
endpoints.description: Lists the payments in one reconciliation, under `data`. An unknown reconciliation returns `404` with the code `resource_not_found`. To filter, add `filter_<field>=<value>`, or `filter_<field>_<operator>=<value>` with an operator such as `gte` or `contains`.

parameters.name: reconciliation_id
parameters.description: The reconciliation's uuid or its numeric id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed to work.** Only the `404` for an unknown reconciliation is confirmed; the response body is not documented yet.
